report.menu.description: The item of a menu about an account (a post's, a profile's, a notification's) that opens the panel that reports the account to the moderators. It sits under the account's handle.

report.menu_room.description: The item of a voice chat room's menu that opens the panel that reports the room and its host to the moderators.

report.menu_event.description: The item of an event's menu that opens the panel that reports the event and its organizer to the moderators.

report.more.description: The name of the button of a voice chat room's or an event's page, for a reader who does not run it, that opens the menu of what else they may do (report it).

report.notification_more.description: The name of the button at the end of a notification's line that opens its menu (reporting the account it is about).

report.failed.defaultMessage: Die Meldung konnte nicht gesendet werden. Prüfe deine Verbindung und versuche es dann erneut.
report.failed.description: Said right before Send report when the report could not be sent and the server gave no reason.
